description: Memory key encoder compiled to the neural ISA: raw text bytes (positions 1..=len of a 256-byte input) to a pooled unit key and per-word unit vectors, the bag of FNV-1a-hashed byte trigrams of '#word#' over core.memory_encoder (docs/memory-format.md). Byte-class gates, ASCII case folding, a window gather, hash_rows, a prefix sum of word starts, one-hot word assignment, and L2 norms. buckets and key_dim equal model/specs/memory.json.
